title: Number Extractor
h1: Number Extractor — Pull Numbers from Text
seoTitle: Free Number Extractor — Extract Digits from Text
description: Extract all numbers from a block of text. Useful for cleaning data or finding numeric values. Runs entirely in the browser.
intro: Paste text containing numbers and extract them as a clean list. No data leaves your browser.
blurb: Find and list every number appearing in a piece of text.
howItWorks: Paste or type text that includes numbers.
Click Extract to find all integer and decimal numbers.
Numbers appear one per line in the output.
examples: The text 'Order 42 items at $19.99 each' yields 42 and 19.99.
Useful for extracting prices, quantities, or IDs from unstructured text.
